answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Inheritance & Will Question ID: 22900 Country: India Title: I am from Middle class family i have some Gold jewellary can i take Loan Against Gold ? For business purpose i dont have any other resources for money .plz Guide me? Question: I am from Middle class family i have some Gold jewellary can i take Loan Against Gold ? For business purpose i dont have any other resources for money .plz Guide me? Answer ID: 22900 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1066/866/B=1431) If you own medium type of business and live respectfully, in this case it is not lawful for you to take loan without dire need; for you will have to pay interest. As taking interest is haram, giving interest is also haram. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
